spans.text: at the start of the second revolution, we had a reference to several objects that the crew spotted.
spans.why: Gemini Control: crew spotted several objects at the start of the second revolution

spans.text: This was in the area of Antigua.
It contains references to sighting not only some particles, but as well as an unidentified object, plus the booster.
spans.why: Gemini Control frames the three distinct things sighted: particles, an unidentified object, the booster

spans.text: We have a bogey at 10 o'clock high.
spans.why: Borman's core report - a bogey at 10 o'clock high

spans.text: We have several, looks like debris up here, actual sighting.
spans.why: Borman confirms an actual sighting, describes it as debris

spans.text: We also have the booster in sight.
spans.why: Borman distinguishes the booster from the bogey - both in sight

spans.text: it looks like hundreds of little particles going by from the left out about three to four miles.
spans.why: Borman: hundreds of particles, three to four miles off

spans.text: Looks like a perhaps a vehicle that's disintegrated.
spans.why: Borman characterises the large object as a disintegrated vehicle

spans.text: It's ahead of us at 2 o'clock, slowly tumbling.
spans.why: Lovell: the object is ahead at 2 o'clock, slowly tumbling

spans.text: This is the unidentified object in addition to particles which appear to be headed in a polar orbit
spans.why: Gemini Control summary: the unidentified object plus particles apparently in a polar orbit

spans.text: It was Borman who reported sighting the bogey.
spans.why: Gemini Control attributes the bogey sighting to Borman
